lead: Coroutine-domain synchronization primitives: `Mutex<T>`, `RwLock<T>`, `Once`, `Barrier`, `Condvar`, `CachePadded<T>`, and `fence(order)`. These primitives may suspend the current coroutine instead of blocking an OS thread, and must be imported explicitly. The target interface of `Mutex.lock`, `Mutex.tryLock` and `RwLock.write` passes a `ref T` to the body, `RwLock.read` passes `T`, and there is no `replace` (spec §10.9); the module does not implement it yet.
